detail: The United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights said last year that human rights in North Korea have shown no improvement over the past decade and had in fact worsened in many cases. (Euronews)
North Korea's UN mission has lashed out at the European Union over a draft UN resolution. Pyongyang has said the West does not have a monopoly on human rights. (DW)

singapore.title: Child abuse cases rise in Malaysia, Indonesia, Singapore. Why?
detail: Malaysia, Indonesia and Singapore have all recorded rising numbers of child abuse cases in recent years, but child welfare advocates say this may be a sign of progress rather than worsening violence, as greater awareness and improved reporting bring more cases to the attention of authorities. (South China Morning Post)

singapore.title: Singapore minister says Cop31 has ‘enough to work on’ without new targets
detail: Global climate talks starting on Monday are unlikely to yield new targets on curbing greenhouse gases, but negotiators have plenty to do to implement measures already agreed, according to Singapore’s environment minister. (South China Morning Post)

detail: The accused fired several rounds at the victim and his son; the victim succumbed to injuries and the son escaped unhurt (The Hindu)

singapore.title: A son in prison, a daughter gone: Singapore parents face heartbreak
detail: When Huang Baoying was growing up, her older brother helped look after her, their parents recalled. Huang Bocan would tutor his younger sister at night and help her with her studies, their mother said. To his parents, he was a responsible son whom they trusted to help care for Baoying while they worked long hours. (South China Morning Post)

detail: Singapore’s People’s Action Party co-opted four additional members into its 39th Central Executive Committee, as the ruling party seeks to strengthen its pipeline of future leaders. (Bloomberg)

singapore.title: How Singapore confronts AI fears of ‘broken’ career ladder, no pause button
detail: Singapore is seeking to flip the script by turning its land and manpower constraints into reasons to embrace AI instead of fearing it, even as the technology carries the spectre of job losses and cyberthreats in the wrong hands, a senior official has said. (South China Morning Post)

singapore.title: Starved, beaten: Singaporean gets life imprisonment for murdering sister
detail: A man was sentenced to life imprisonment on Thursday for murder after being part of a group that abused his 19-year-old younger sister until she died. (South China Morning Post)

detail: New Zealand’s election remains too close to call, but voters have already delivered a decisive verdict on the major parties, handing smaller rivals their best-ever results and reshaping the country’s political landscape. (Bloomberg)

detail: Neither current Prime Minister Christopher Luxon nor opposition leader Chris Hipkins claimed victory in their speeches following the election. (The Japan Times)

kathmandu.title: Nepal’s remaining Bhutanese refugees seek legal recognition
detail: Thousands of Bhutanese refugees living in camps in Jhapa and Morang districts in eastern Nepal are still waiting for legal recognition that would allow them to work, study, and build secure lives in Nepal, more than three decades after leaving their homeland. (Inquirer)

kathmandu.title: Dashain gone, Tihar uncertain: Nepali workers stranded in Saudi Arabia as Houthi attacks disrupt flights
detail: KATHMANDU: Rajesh Rai from Khotang was preparing to return home after three years in Saudi Arabia to celebrate Dashain with family. His employer had granted him a month’s leave and he had an exit-re-entry visa. He had booked an October 11 Air Arabia flight from Riyadh to Kathmandu via Sharjah. (Dawn)

kathmandu.title: Indian national killed after 2 helicopters collide in Nepal's Mount Everest region
detail: Authorities have confirmed that a 47-year-old Indian national was killed and two people injured. (Al Jazeera)

An Indian national was killed and a New Zealander injured after two helicopters collided as they prepared to land in Nepal’s Mount Everest region on Tuesday, authorities said. The New Zealander has been rescued, the chief district officer of Solukhumbu district, Kaman Singh Thapa Magar, told Reuters . (Dawn)

kathmandu.title: In first high-level visit after new government’s arrival, Foreign Secretary Misri to visit Nepal on November 4-5
detail: Misri’s visit to include discussions on Prime Minister Balendra Shah’s visit to India; appointment of Nepal’s new Ambassador to India and disaster assistance following the flash floods are also expected to be on the agenda (The Hindu)

nuuk.title: Greenland's parliament ratifies Trump's US security agreement
detail: Lawmakers vote 16-0 for trilateral agreement signed in September, while seven abstained. (Al Jazeera)

Greenland’s parliament on Tuesday ratified the Arctic ⁠island’s security agreement ⁠struck earlier this year with US ⁠President Donald Trump, although some opposition party members questioned the deal’s economic value. (South China Morning Post)
